summary: SOCITAS, a Microsoft partner, describes hiring six people (three consultants, three developers) through the Business Central talent program. It is partner testimony on recruitment and team growth, with brief remarks on Business Central speed and API use with AI models.
overview:
A short #BCTalent Stories video from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central channel, published 2024-08-09. A SOCITAS representative talks about their motivation to help people optimize processes and about their experience recruiting through the Business Central talent program.

They say the search started in late summer of the previous year and ended with six new hires: three consultants and three developers. They describe the process as smooth, credit the Business Central team for helping find people, and recommend that Microsoft partners join the program. They also say Business Central is faster and has more possibilities than other ERP solutions, for example using an API with an AI model to improve business processes.
key_points: SOCITAS hired six new people through the program: three consultants and three developers.
The recruitment search started in late summer of the year before the video and was described as a smooth, pleasant journey.
The speaker credits the Business Central team with helping to find people.
The speaker recommends that Microsoft partners join the talent program.
The speaker says Business Central is faster than other ERP solutions and offers extensive possibilities.
One example given is using an API with an AI model to improve business processes.
